text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from my outing with
Aston
Machan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Screech! ...Thud!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heeeyo! ♪ Look who it is! What a
coinkydink!
What's poppin'?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well,
if it isn't Maruzen. Hello there. I'm
fine,
thanks. We're just on our way back
to campus.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Sorry for stopping you out of the
blue. I
just saw a familiar face and
couldn't resist saying
hi.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem at all. Like I said, we
were just
heading back, so... it's...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't tell me. Tata caught your eye?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, yes. Who could miss such a
wonderful,
bright red sports car?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My father sells foreign cars, so I have a
bit of an
eye for them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Plus...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have a fond memory involving cars.
When I was
younger, my father drove
the family to the beach.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We told stories and laughed for the
whole ride...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That settles it. Once I'm old enough, I'm
getting a
driver's license.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'm going to hit the road in a
sports car
you'll see coming miles away!
I'll call it Machan's
memory-mobile.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What a groovy dream! ♪ You know
what, I'm
going to give you a helping
hand with getting
that license!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: How exactly?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Listen, driving's something you have to
feel with
your whole body! Come on,
hop inside Tata and
I'll show you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them get in the car and drive
off. And
before I can say "hot rod"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrooooom... Screech!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We're back! I was planning to go a bit
longer, to
tell the truth, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please... No more...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't ask...
Just thinking about
it... makes me...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The roaring engine... The dizzying turns
and
screeching of hot rubber...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did you know cars can shake vertically
too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's happening? Is it just me or
is the
whole world spinning?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not built for this. I'm wiping the
entire
experience from my mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to forget about all of it. Every
last
detail.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaaah, I might've gunned it a little
too hard
back there. Or maybe we got
too much air?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaaah, I might've gunned it a little
too hard
back there. Or maybe we got
too much air?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, especially when we were driving by
the oce—
choice_data_list: That really was some grueling trai...
That really was some grueling trai...
Hearing you talk about it got me k...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm wiping everything from my mind.
I was
never in any car.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her face completely drained of color,
Aston
Machan decides not to get a
driver's license after
all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I implore you to reconsider. No human
can
withstand a ride like that!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But if you really insist on taking a
ride in
a car, I'll
get a license and drive you
instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan is dead serious as she
warns me off getting in the car. It must
have been quite a
traumatic experience
for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I heed the advice, then guide a frazzled
Aston
Machan back to the dorm.
